mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupon ORDER BY coupon_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (coupon_code, coupon_name, coupon_type, discount_amount, minimum_amount, start_time, end_time, coupon_status, coupon_stock, coupon_message, status, user_id) VALUES (#{couponCode}, #{couponName}, #{couponType}, #{discountAmount}, #{minimumAmount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{couponStatus}, #{couponStock}, #{couponMessage}, #{status}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET coupon_code = #{couponCode}, coupon_name = #{couponName}, coupon_type = #{couponType}, discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, minimum_amount = #{minimumAmount}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, coupon_status = #{couponStatus}, coupon_stock = #{couponStock}, coupon_message = #{couponMessage}, status = #{status}, user_id = #{userId} WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}
